caption: The drawing depicts a dress design on a beige background, focused on a mannequin-like figure without a head, hands, or feet. The main object is a dress with a fitted bodice and a full skirt extending to the ground. The bodice is yellow and decorated with a pattern of small dots and clusters of watercolor-style floral designs in pink, blue, purple, and green hues. The bodice has short sleeves and thin straps, with a pointed lower edge at the front. The skirt is outlined in thin, light pencil without any color or shading, occupying the majority of the lower part of the drawing. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller sketch of the dress viewed from the back, showing the structure of the bodice with seam lines but without any color or floral patterns. The background is plain and unadorned apart from some slight texture and scattered small spots, indicating the age or medium of the paper.
title: Design for Bodice
